function.name: Finance and accounting
function.description: Recording, reconciling, closing, forecasting and paying.

jobs.name: Categorize expenses to the chart of accounts
jobs.outcome: Every expense lands in the account and cost center a controller would choose.

jobs.name: Draft the commentary explaining budget variances
jobs.outcome: Each material variance in the monthly pack carries a draft explanation grounded in the underlying transactions.

jobs.name: Flag transactions that look wrong before they post
jobs.outcome: Duplicates, unusual amounts, odd counterparties and policy breaches are flagged before money moves.

jobs.name: Forecast cash position over the coming weeks
jobs.outcome: A rolling cash forecast that a treasurer trusts for the next 13 weeks, updated as receivables and payables move.

jobs.name: Match supplier invoices to purchase orders and receipts
jobs.outcome: An incoming invoice is matched to its order and receipt lines, with exceptions surfaced, without manual keying.

jobs.name: Reconcile bank and ledger balances
jobs.outcome: Bank lines and ledger entries are matched and every unmatched item is explained or queued, by the close date.
